ground_truth_policy: Independently curated. Must have at least 1 primary relevant evidence item and 1 supporting evidence item for higher-risk cases. Relevance and authority are kept strictly separate.
deduplication_policy: Hierarchical deduplication: 1. Strong Identifier (PMID, PMCID, DOI), 2. Normalized Title, 3. Content Hash. Retain provenance for merged records.
provenance_policy: Every document must preserve document_id, chunk_id, source, source_type, source_identifier, PMID, PMCID, DOI, RxCUI, publication_date, authority_tier, provenance, content_hash.
snapshot_policy: Staged acquisition. Stage A (100 documents) -> Validate -> Stage B (250 documents) -> Validate. Documents will be chunked honoring section context and frozen in experiments/evidence_snapshots/retrieval-v2/.
